source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: decimal notation is settled by running 'Convert measurements or money between a smaller unit and a larger unit': If a larger unit is made of 10, 100, or 1000 smaller units, then one smaller unit is 1/10 — on the item about Decide whether a point in a real-world notation is a.

intelligence.enrichment: Decimal notation splits a unit into tenths, hundredths, thousandths, and so on, but some real-world notations use a point-like mark with units that are not divided by ten, so the unit context must be checked before interpreting the number.
